title: StarStruck
description: A mod that adds Starstruck enchantment to the game. The enchantment increases attack damage and gives a special passive ability.
body:
# StarStruck

This mod adds a new enchantment: Starstruck

This enchantment has 3 levels, I-III

### What it does:
- Increase base damage output by [enchant level] x 100%
- Adds Explosion-On-Kill to Starstruck III

### How to obtain:
- This enchantment is not obtainable via Enchanting Table
- It can be applied to a weapon by putting the weapon in the middle slot of a crafting table, then surround it with 4 nether stars
- This process can be repeated 2 more times to obtain higher enchantment levels

#### Compatible Weapons: Spear, Sword, Mace, and Trident

p.s. This is my very first Minecraft mods so feedbacks are greatly appreciated!
